mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_evidence_inbox(tenant_id,issuer,source_system,event_id,business_digest,order_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{issuer},#{source},#{eventId},#{digest},#{orderId},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=event_id
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant,issuer,source_system AS source,event_id AS eventId,business_digest AS businessDigest,order_id AS orderId, result_resource_id AS resourceId,result_outcome AS outcome,result_reason AS reason,result_state_version AS stateVersion FROM mk_referral_evidence_inbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND issuer=#{issuer} AND source_system=#{source} AND event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_order_evidence_current(tenant_id,source_system,order_id,resource_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{source},#{orderId},#{resourceId},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant,source_system AS source,order_id AS orderId,resource_id AS resourceId,row_version AS rowVersion,quarantined, subject_key AS subject,subject_key_version AS keyVersion,organization_id AS organization,shop_id AS shop,business_revision AS revision, state_cipher AS cipher,encryption_key_id AS keyId,state_digest AS businessDigest FROM mk_referral_order_evidence_current WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_system=#{source} AND order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id AS tenant,source_system AS source,order_id AS orderId,subject_key AS subject,subject_key_version AS keyVersion, organization_id AS organization,shop_id AS shop,business_revision AS revision,snapshot_cipher AS cipher,encryption_key_id AS keyId,business_digest AS businessDigest FROM mk_referral_order_evidence_history WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_system=#{source} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND business_revision=#{revision} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_evidence_inbox SET result_resource_id=#{resourceId},result_outcome=#{outcome},result_reason=#{reason},result_state_version=#{stateVersion},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND issuer=#{issuer} AND source_system=#{source} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND result_resource_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_evidence_fanout(tenant_id,resource_id,desired_version,reason,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{resourceId},#{version},#{reason},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE desired_version=GREATEST(desired_version,VALUES(desired_version)),reason=VALUES(reason), status='PENDING',cursor_relation_id=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,lease_fence=lease_fence+1,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
